title: LLM Integration Module
summary: This module provides a unified interface for integrating with various Large Language Models (LLMs), offering abstract base classes and concrete implementations for providers like Anthropic, Azure, Bedrock, Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible services. It handles message formatting, tool calling, streaming, authentication, and event emission across different LLM platforms.

nodes.label: Base LLM Interface
nodes.title: BaseLLM
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface and common functionalities for all LLM integrations, including message formatting, event emission, token tracking, and structured output validation.

nodes.label: Anthropic LLM Integration
nodes.title: AnthropicCompletion
nodes.description: Provides native integration with Anthropic's API, supporting Claude models, tool use, streaming, and specific message formatting for optimal interaction.

nodes.label: Azure AI LLM Integration
nodes.title: AzureCompletion
nodes.description: Integrates with Azure AI Inference, supporting Azure OpenAI models, function calling, streaming, and Azure-specific authentication and endpoint handling.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock LLM Integration
nodes.title: BedrockCompletion
nodes.description: Connects to AWS Bedrock's Converse API, offering tool calling, streaming, guardrail configuration, and handling of various Bedrock models like Claude and Amazon Nova.

nodes.label: Google Gemini LLM Integration
nodes.title: GeminiCompletion
nodes.description: Integrates with Google Gen AI SDK for Gemini models, supporting function calling, streaming, safety settings, and specific message/structured output formatting.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible LLM Integration
nodes.title: OpenAICompatibleCompletion
nodes.description: Extends OpenAI integration to support various OpenAI-compatible APIs (e.g., OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama) by resolving provider-specific configurations.

nodes.label: Anthropic API
nodes.title: Anthropic API
nodes.description: External service providing large language models from Anthropic (e.g., Claude).

nodes.label: Azure AI Inference
nodes.title: Azure AI Inference
nodes.description: External service providing large language models hosted on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock
nodes.title: AWS Bedrock
nodes.description: External service providing access to foundation models from Amazon and third-party providers (e.g., Anthropic, Cohere) on AWS.

nodes.label: Google Gemini API
nodes.title: Google Gemini API
nodes.description: External service providing access to Google's Gemini family of large language models.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible APIs
nodes.title: OpenAI-Compatible APIs
nodes.description: Various external services that offer APIs compatible with OpenAI's specification, such as OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and Ollama.

nodes.label: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.title: CrewAIEventsBus
nodes.description: Handles the emission and listening of various events within the CrewAI framework, including LLM call lifecycle events.

nodes.label: Tool Conversion Utilities
nodes.title: Tool Conversion
nodes.description: Provides utilities for converting CrewAI tool definitions into formats compatible with specific LLM providers for function calling.

nodes.label: File Upload Service
nodes.title: FileUploader
nodes.description: Manages the uploading of files to LLM providers for multimodal input, leveraging provider-specific clients.

nodes.label: LLM Call Hooks
nodes.title: LLM Hooks
nodes.description: Allows custom logic to be injected before and after LLM calls for direct LLM interactions, enabling extensibility and monitoring.
